rules.rule: An edge exists only where something changes; where nothing changes, there is no shape or hierarchy.
rules.evidence: an edge exists only where something changes. Where nothing changes there is no edge, and where there is no edge there is no shape.

rules.rule: High contrast creates an intense mood while low contrast creates a quiet mood; neither is inherently good or bad.
rules.evidence: high and low contrast are two moods rather than a good setting and a bad one — high contrast reads intense, low contrast reads quiet, and neither is a score
